attack.failure: Keeping H intact for impact fastening prevents its M and S from serving the supported non-impact assemblies. Discrete fastening and the impact preference alone cannot eliminate those assemblies. Conversely, novelty alone cannot displace the feasible lower-burden clip incumbent.
attack.invariant: The same two panels retain at least 4 units at ticks 3-6, then separate with every installed retainer removed by boundary 10; no damage, substitution, discard or outside resource.
attack.permitted_variable: Choose among C installation, detached S inserted in V, and detached M held by routed L. Only listed primitives and existing identities are available.

budget_used.allocation: Declared before outcome checks: zero breadth slots and six depth slots. Fix the source-listed clip, stem-sleeve and head-loop constructions as the three-family comparison set; use two local concern passes per family through shared checks. No new families or fresh builder.
budget_used.limits: Six bounded local passes, not independent agents; word caps are not equal compute. No experiments, external search or measured outcomes.

handoff.residue: Both detached-component schedules have no preparation slack before boundary 3. Their sixth active action restores H voluntarily; the required function needs five. Equal capacities and action counts do not prove equal physical behavior.
handoff.summary: Replay J0-C, J0-SV and J0-ML exactly. One operator, next-boundary completion, original identities, no pin/non-pin mixtures and one non-pin assembly maximum. Preserve retention >=4 at ticks 3-6 and remove everything by 10. C installs at 0/removes at 7. SV detaches at 0, installs V at 1, inserts S,V at 2, withdraws at 7, removes V at 8, assembles H at 9. ML substitutes place M at 1, route L at 2, unroute L at 7, lift M at 8. Idle otherwise. No Q assumption, task deletion, ownership exchange or invented capacity. All predictions remain finite-model claims pending root replay.

limits: Synthetic axioms support modeled schedules, not measured physics or final success grading.
The archive establishes C as conventional; its absence of SV/ML does not establish universal novelty.
The impact preference remains 2; all candidates use zero taps without changing a ladder cell.
No uncertainty can be resolved by assuming Q_theta=4. No global optimum or independent validation claimed.
